headline: US Dollar Holds Near 19-Month High as AI Jitters Drive Safe-Haven Bids
summary: The US dollar index held near 103.9, close to a 19-month high, headed for a fourth consecutive weekly gain as risk aversion from technology stocks sent investors into safe havens.
why: The US dollar is the global reserve currency; strong dollar rallies typically tighten international liquidity and pressure emerging-market assets and risk-sensitive currencies.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: The greenback remained elevated near 103.9 on safe-haven demand.
